speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor

text: RESULTS: External Genitalia: Normal, no lesions or masses; Speculum Exam: Vaginal atrophy, no active bleeding; Bimanual Exam: A palpable left adnexal mass, non-tender, uterus non-enlarged

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal CT scan and non-tender adnexal mass in the setting of endometrial cancer suggest a benign process like an ovarian cyst rather than metastatic disease. I will request medical images to further characterize the mass.

text: The combination of postmenopausal bleeding, a thickened endometrial stripe, and a biopsy confirming well-differentiated adenocarcinoma points directly to endometrial cancer.
